summary: Gakpo has a calf (soleus) strain from international duty and hasn't trained since the break; Everton on 29 Nov is a 'chance' at best. Szoboszlai started and scored 9 against Man Utd.

claims.text: Soleus (calf) injury picked up with the Netherlands; not trained with Liverpool since the break; no return date given.
claims.source_name: Sports Mole, Iraola explains Gakpo absence

claims.text: Possible return against Everton on 29 November, but expected to miss midweek; a mild strain would mean up to two weeks out.
claims.source_name: Sports Mole, Liverpool injury list vs Club Brugge
